race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
race.verdict: Lots with chances but MR NUGGET signalled he is ready to strike again when a recent runner-up at Wolverhampton and can go one better off the same mark here. Cancan In The Rain wasn't seen to ideal effect when fifth at Kempton last time and could emerge as the main threat off an easing mark, although Celestias Comet and Fallacious Promise also need factoring into this very open handicap. MR NUGGET CANCAN IN THE RAIN (IRE) CELESTIAS COMET (IRE)
